entrypoints.name: encode

returns.constraint: one positive count and representative per maximal, non-empty contiguous equal-value run, in input traversal order

entrypoints.infinite_streams: not applicable; contract is over finite OCaml lists
entrypoints.equality_note: Run boundaries use OCaml polymorphic equality, consistent with a polymorphic 'a list interface.

data Run a where Run :: x:a -> xs:List {a | _v == x} -> Run a; data Runs a

Runs a -> Bool> where RNil :: Runs a

trusted_primitive_declarations.name: structural lowering
trusted_primitive_declarations.declaration: Run x xs -> (1 + length xs, x); RNil -> []; RCons r rs -> lower r :: lower rs
trusted_primitive_declarations.role: typed backend conversion from the positive structural Synquid representation to OCaml (int * 'a) list
trusted_primitive_declarations.category: backend responsibility; not a synthesized final algorithm

lowering_boundary: No OCaml implementation is supplied. Any Synquid candidate remains a candidate until a backend mechanically lowers it and the independent OCaml semantic tests pass.
